incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A ruined building with collapsed walls and debris lies in a damaged urban area, with surrounding structures and vegetation visible.

observations.description: A multi-story building is heavily damaged with collapsed sections and exposed interiors.
A tall pole stands near the wreckage, and a partially ruined structure is on the left.
A tree is visible in the background among the ruins.
Debris includes broken wood, metal sheets, and household items scattered around the rubble.
A white sack sits on a concrete block in the foreground.
Other buildings are visible in the background, showing moderate damage or intact structure.
